name: Update Row/Cell
plugin_description: Integrates with Google Sheets to read, search, and write rows from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Updates specific cells within one row, keyed by header name. Targets the row either by row_number (e.g. from a prior Search Rows) or by match_column/match_value. Only the columns present in row_data are changed — everything else in the row is left untouched. If match_column/match_value matches more than one row, set update_all to update every matching row instead of raising an error.

inputs.name: spreadsheet_id
inputs.label: Spreadsheet ID
inputs.hint: The ID from the sheet's URL: .../spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheet_id}/edit

inputs.name: sheet_name
inputs.label: Sheet Name
inputs.hint: The tab name at the bottom of the spreadsheet, e.g. Sheet1.

inputs.name: row_data
inputs.label: Row Data
inputs.hint: JSON object string keyed by header name, e.g. {"Status": "Inactive"}. Only these columns are updated; everything else in the row is left as-is. A key that isn't a real header raises an error.

inputs.name: header_row
inputs.label: Header Row
inputs.hint: Which row contains the column headers (1-indexed). Leave blank to default to 1.

inputs.name: header_column
inputs.label: Header Column
inputs.hint: Which column the headers start in (1-indexed). Columns to the left are ignored. Leave blank to default to 1.

inputs.name: row_number
inputs.label: Row Number
inputs.hint: Real 1-indexed sheet row to update, typically from a prior Search Rows. Provide this OR match_column + match_value, not both. A string, not a number, since there's no sensible default value for "which row" to fall back to when left blank.

inputs.name: match_column
inputs.label: Match Column
inputs.hint: Header name to search for the row to update. Provide this (with match_value) OR row_number, not both.

inputs.name: match_value
inputs.label: Match Value
inputs.hint: Required if match_column is set. If more than one row matches exactly, every matching row is updated unless update_all is explicitly set to false.

inputs.name: update_all
inputs.label: Update All Matches
inputs.hint: Only applies to match_column/match_value targeting. If true, every row matching match_column/match_value is updated. If false, requires an exact single match, raising an ambiguous-match error otherwise. Has no effect when targeting by row_number. Must be set explicitly — there is no functional default.

outputs.name: rows_updated
outputs.label: Rows Updated
outputs.hint: The real 1-indexed sheet row(s) that were updated. If update_all is false, this is a single number (e.g. 5). If update_all is true, this is a JSON array string of every updated row (e.g. [5, 6, 7]), even if only one row matched.
